description: Render a public web page (url) or raw HTML (html) to PDF. A url prints as it looks on a desktop screen and is scrolled through first, so content that loads or appears on scroll is in the PDF. Returns the PDF as an embedded resource.

html.description: Raw HTML (max 1 MB); use instead of url

margin.description: CSS length for all sides, e.g. 10mm, 0.5in

media.description: screen: the page as it looks on a desktop screen, scaled to fit the paper (best for landing and pricing pages). print: the page's print styles at the paper width, like a browser's Print dialog (best for articles and documents). Default: screen for url, print for html.

scroll.description: Scroll through the page before printing. Default true for url, false for html.

width.description: Layout width in CSS px, scaled to fit the paper. Default: 1280 with media screen, the paper width with media print.

name: render_pdf
title: Render a PDF
